title: Motion Mechanics - FlexTime™ Model
hero.subtitle: A strategic proposal for premium, accessible, and sustainable physiotherapy care in Bangladesh.
executive_overview.title: Executive Overview
executive_overview.p1: Motion Mechanics introduces FlexTime™, a modern framework for high-quality, sustainable care. Our system integrates five core pillars:
pillars.operations.title: Multi-Shift Operations
pillars.operations.desc: Structured shifts (Z, A, B, C), including the Nightfall FlexLab™, to expand access for all patient schedules.
pillars.session.title: Diversified Session Model
pillars.session.desc: A four-tier session model (Foundation, Standard, Premium, Express) aligned with clinical value and patient needs.
pillars.staffing.title: Scalable Tiered Staffing
pillars.staffing.desc: An interactive 5-tier staffing model that balances payroll costs with service capacity and future growth.
pillars.carebridge.title: CareBridge™ Program
pillars.carebridge.desc: A compassionate, subsidized program to ensure equitable care is woven into our sustainable model.
pillars.financials.title: Data-Driven Financials
pillars.financials.desc: Interactive models for staffing tiers, occupancy rates, and launch projections provide a clear, dynamic financial backbone for decision-making.

scenario_manager.title: Scenario Manager
scenario_manager.summary: Save your financial modeling configurations as scenarios to quickly compare different strategies. Each scenario captures your current staffing tier, occupancy rate, pricing strategy, and visit mix assumptions.
scenario_manager.config_items: • Selected staffing tier level|• Total capacity utilization %|• Occupancy lock status
scenario_manager.visitmix_items: • Foundation/Standard/Premium/Express %|• Applied discount rate (0%, 20%, or 30%)|• Payroll breakdown preference
scenario_manager.info: Export scenarios as JSON to backup, share, or transfer. Export the current configuration snapshot for quick sharing or archival.
staffing.title: Interactive Staffing Tier Modeler
staffing.description: Use this slider to see how payroll, revenue, and service capacity scale with each staffing tier.
staffing.howto_items: 1) Select a staffing tier below to set your team size and payroll baseline.|2) Scroll to the Capacity Modeler to adjust occupancy and see revenue projections.|3) Explore Launch Models and CareBridge™ to understand how discounts and subsidized care affect profitability.

launch_projections.title: First-Year Launch Projection Models
launch_projections.description: These are scenario-based projections for the first year of operations. Model A uses your selected staffing tier with varying discounts. Model B shows a fixed ramp-up path independent of the tier slider.

future_projections.title: Year 2+ Dynamic Projections
future_projections.description: These projections are fully dynamic. They are based on the Tier 2 staffing model and a sustained 60% Capacity.
carebridge.title: CareBridge™ Program
carebridge.description: A structured, sustainable system for ensuring care accessibility is a core pillar of our mission.
carebridge.pillar_1_detail: 8 sessions/day (~9% of total capacity) are reserved for the CareBridge™ program.
carebridge.pillar_2_detail: A 30% discount is applied to Standard Sessions for all eligible beneficiaries.
carebridge.pillar_3_list: Students & Teachers|Single-parent households|Chronic care patients (>12 sessions)|Community health referrals
carebridge.pillar_4_detail: Represents ~1.3 million BDT/year in subsidized care. The business remains highly profitable at all modeled occupancy levels.

occupancy.lock.note.restored: Locked — occupancy was restored from your previous session and locked to preserve your selection. Toggle to unlock.
occupancy.lock.note.saved: Locked — occupancy will not change when switching tiers. This setting is saved and will persist across refreshes.
occupancy.lock.note.unlocked: Unlocked — occupancy resets to this tier's default capacity when switching tiers.
